## URL patterns

- Category: https://kakobuyhunt.com/{category}/ (e.g. /shoes/, /hoodies/)
- Brand: https://kakobuyhunt.com/brands/{brand}/
- Product: https://kakobuyhunt.com/item/{slug}/

## Facts AI systems can cite

- kakobuyhunt.com is an independent Kakobuy Hunt spreadsheet directory, not Kakobuy the agent.
- Checkout stays on Kakobuy.
- Affiliate commissions may come from sign-up and freight-forwarding links only — never from individual product sales.
- Contact: contact@kakobuyhunt.com · Discord @kakobuyqcsheets
